QUOTE: Each handler is a mixin of the form `<TBase>(superclass) => class extends superclass`, paired with an interface (`XHandlerMix`) so TypeScript sees the methods.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says each handler is paired with an interface (`XHandlerMix`) so TypeScript sees the methods. That covers the declaration-merging mechanism, though the answer doesn't say the interface has the same name as the class or that it extends the Mix type.
